sections.title: p. 195

summary.text: Concludes in Section 7 ("Arbitrary manifolds") by defining the link structure of an open 3-manifold M, exhibiting two manifolds with infinite cyclic fundamental group (S^2 x S^1 and R^2 x S^1, and their punctured homotopy-equivalent counterparts) that have non-isomorphic 1-link groups, posing the open question of whether the link structure of a closed 3-manifold is determined by its homotopy type, and listing the four references (Chen, Fox, Reidemeister).
